last_shipit.summary: Module-Level Version Tracking System - Phases A-G COMPLETE. Implemented granular module version tracking with sub-versioning (2.0-N), controlled vocabulary validation, CLI visibility commands, and automated changelog generation. Created 4 major commits with ~4,000 lines of structured metadata infrastructure. Features: zero-ambiguity metadata, auto-fixing deprecated terms, module dirty/clean state tracking, pending lug visibility, automated markdown changelogs grouped by module and category.
